_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: THE SMCI ROW IS PRUNED, TWO NIGHTS LATE, BY THE FIRST RUN THAT COULD READ WHAT THE PRINT DID - which is the whole reason it was correctly left standing twice. The 8/11 pre-close refused to prune it because the print landed after the 16:00 close and deleting an unhappened catalyst is the inverse of this file's job. The 8/12 open and pre-close both declined at the staleness guard, 846 and 489 minutes late, and a declined run may not read a quote, so neither could discharge the branch attached to the row; both said so and handed it here. This run has the quotes and discharges it. WHAT THE BRANCH SAID AND WHAT IT DECIDED. The third branch read 'SMCI still wanted after the print - re-approach from 8/12, on the reaction bar rather than into it', with the qualifier that 'the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2/3 pullback that holds is', and it named the 8/12 open as its owner. That owner never fired. Discharged today on live numbers: the print produced a 31.60-to-37.61 gap on 8/12, +19.0% on 165.7M shares against a 56.6M average, and today is day 2 at a 39.61 bid, +5.32%, with a 38.20 session low that sits ABOVE yesterday's close. So the reaction bar has passed and the pullback has not arrived. The branch's own test therefore ANSWERS AGAINST an entry here, and the entry was published anyway - marked forced on item 2, with the branch quoted in the reasoning rather than quietly deleted underneath it. That is the distinction this prune is trying to preserve: the row goes because its date has passed, not because its answer was inconvenient. THE FILE IS NOW EMPTY AND THAT IS THE ACCURATE STATE. The earnings calendar was pulled live at 502 events across 8/13 to 8/19 and NOT ONE of the twelve watched names appears in it. No catalyst is ahead for anything this board follows, which is a fact worth having recorded plainly - it is the reason every alternative to today's entry failed item 1, and an empty moves.json is the honest way to say it rather than a file kept populated to look busy. The 14.4% implied move and the 8/14 straddle that produced it are not carried forward: they priced an event that has happened, and re-quoting them now would be describing a resolved uncertainty as a live one.
